tiers.command: dart run dev/tools/embed_assets.dart && dart analyze --fatal-infos && dart test --reporter=failures-only packages/dartclaw_kernel && dart test --reporter=failures-only packages/dartclaw_core && dart test --reporter=failures-only packages/dartclaw_workflow && dart test --reporter=failures-only packages/dartclaw_runtime && dart test --reporter=failures-only -x slow apps/dartclaw_cli

proofs.command: bash -c 'rg -q '"'"'\$\{DARTCLAW_DATABASE_URL\}'"'"' docs/guide/postgresql.md && rg -q '"'"'credential:'"'"' docs/guide/postgresql.md && rg -q '"'"'backend: postgres'"'"' docs/guide/postgresql.md && rg -q '"'"'pool_size'"'"' docs/guide/postgresql.md && rg -q '"'"'fts_language'"'"' docs/guide/postgresql.md && rg -q '"'"'verify-full'"'"' docs/guide/postgresql.md && rg -q '"'"'sslmode=disable'"'"' docs/guide/postgresql.md && rg -q '"'"'CREATE ROLE'"'"' docs/guide/postgresql.md && rg -qi '"'"'superuser'"'"' docs/guide/postgresql.md && rg -q '"'"'PostgreSQL 14'"'"' docs/guide/postgresql.md && rg -qi '"'"'data processor'"'"' docs/guide/postgresql.md && rg -qi '"'"'snapshot'"'"' docs/guide/postgresql.md && rg -qi '"'"'at.rest'"'"' docs/guide/postgresql.md && rg -q '"'"'dartclaw rebuild-index'"'"' docs/guide/postgresql.md && rg -q '"'"'turn_state\.json'"'"' docs/guide/postgresql.md && rg -q '"'"'webhook_deliveries/'"'"' docs/guide/postgresql.md && rg -q '"'"'dartclaw\.db'"'"' docs/guide/postgresql.md && rg -qi '"'"'never transfer|no data is transferred|transfers no data'"'"' docs/guide/postgresql.md && rg -qi '"'"'abandoned|could not verify'"'"' docs/guide/postgresql.md && rg -qi '"'"'reset|recreate'"'"' docs/guide/postgresql.md && rg -qi '"'"'restore'"'"' docs/guide/postgresql.md && rg -qi '"'"'sprang'"'"' docs/guide/postgresql.md && rg -qi '"'"'diacritic'"'"' docs/guide/postgresql.md && rg -qi '"'"'second .*serve|advisory lock|already (held|serving)'"'"' docs/guide/postgresql.md && ! rg -qi '"'"'automatic(ally)? upgrad|upgraded in place|migrates your data'"'"' docs/guide/postgresql.md && ! rg -q '"'"'://[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+:[^<*$@/ ][^@/ ]*@'"'"' docs/guide/postgresql.md && rg -q '"'"'postgresql\.md'"'"' docs/guide/README.md docs/guide/deployment.md && rg -qi '"'"'postgresql'"'"' <(awk '"'"'/^## \[Unreleased\]/,/^## \[0/'"'"' CHANGELOG.md) && (cd docs/guide && for f in $(rg --no-filename -oN '"'"'\]\(([^)#: ]+\.md)'"'"' -r '"'"'$1'"'"' postgresql.md README.md | sort -u); do test -e "$f" || { echo "missing $f"; exit 1; }; done)'

bash -c 'for k in database.backend database.url database.credential database.pool_size database.fts_language; do rg -q "^$k  # " dev/tools/config_reference_core_keys.txt || exit 1; done && test "$(grep -cv '"'"'^\s*#\|^\s*$'"'"' dev/tools/config_reference_core_keys.txt)" -le 90 && dart run dev/tools/render_config_reference.dart --check && dart run packages/dartclaw_kernel/tool/generate_config_schema.dart --check && test "$(rg -c '"'"'^\| \x60database\.'"'"' <(awk '"'"'/^### Core Config/,/^### Full Config Reference/'"'"' docs/guide/configuration.md))" = 5 && bash dev/tools/fitness/test_render_config_reference.sh'

bash -c 'rg -q '"'"'^### PostgreSQL Language-Aware Search'"'"' docs/guide/search.md && rg -q '"'"'fts_language'"'"' docs/guide/search.md && rg -q '"'"'rebuild-index'"'"' <(awk '"'"'/^### PostgreSQL Language-Aware Search/,/^### Memory Curation|^## /'"'"' docs/guide/search.md) && rg -qi '"'"'diacritic'"'"' docs/guide/search.md && rg -qi '"'"'sprang|irregular'"'"' docs/guide/search.md && rg -q '"'"'postgresql\.md'"'"' docs/guide/search.md && test "$(rg -n '"'"'^### PostgreSQL Language-Aware Search'"'"' docs/guide/search.md | cut -d: -f1)" -lt "$(rg -n '"'"'^### Memory Curation'"'"' docs/guide/search.md | cut -d: -f1)" && ! rg -q '"'"'S0[0-9]|S1[0-9]|TI0[0-9]|story S'"'"' docs/guide/search.md docs/guide/postgresql.md docs/guide/README.md'

bash -c 'rg -q '"'"'^### Database Backend'"'"' dev/architecture/data-model.md && rg -q '"'"'PostgresBackend'"'"' dev/architecture/data-model.md && rg -qi '"'"'pg_dump|provider backup'"'"' dev/architecture/data-model.md && ! rg -q '"'"'core \+ storage|\(runtime \+ sqlite3\)'"'"' dev/architecture/data-model.md && rg -q '"'"'Database Connection Egress'"'"' dev/architecture/security-architecture.md && rg -q '"'"'verify-full'"'"' dev/architecture/security-architecture.md && rg -qi '"'"'DSN'"'"' <(awk '"'"'/^### MessageRedactor/,/^## /'"'"' dev/architecture/security-architecture.md) && rg -q '"'"'^\| \x60database\x60 \| \x60DatabaseConfig\x60 \| \x60restart\x60'"'"' dev/architecture/configuration-architecture.md && rg -q '"'"'database\.\*'"'"' <(awk '"'"'/^### What.s Hot-Reloadable/,/^### Restart Banner/'"'"' dev/architecture/configuration-architecture.md) && rg -q '"'"'database\.credential'"'"' dev/architecture/configuration-architecture.md && rg -q '"'"'^\*\*Current through\*\*: 0\.26'"'"' dev/architecture/data-model.md dev/architecture/configuration-architecture.md && ! rg -q '"'"'(packages/|package:)dartclaw_(storage|server|config|models|security)\b'"'"' dev/architecture/data-model.md dev/architecture/security-architecture.md dev/architecture/configuration-architecture.md docs/guide/postgresql.md && ! rg -q '"'"'S0[0-9]|S1[0-9]|TI0[0-9]|story S'"'"' dev/architecture/data-model.md dev/architecture/security-architecture.md dev/architecture/configuration-architecture.md'

bash -c 'rg -q '"'"'^\| Database Backend \|'"'"' dev/state/UBIQUITOUS_LANGUAGE.md && rg -q '"'"'^\| Schema Compatibility Gate \|'"'"' dev/state/UBIQUITOUS_LANGUAGE.md && rg -q '"'"'user_id'"'"' <(rg '"'"'^\| Full-Text Index \|'"'"' dev/state/UBIQUITOUS_LANGUAGE.md) && rg -qi '"'"'conversation'"'"' <(rg '"'"'^\| Full-Text Index \|'"'"' dev/state/UBIQUITOUS_LANGUAGE.md) && rg -qi '"'"'not a global'"'"' <(rg '"'"'^\| Full-Text Index \|'"'"' dev/state/UBIQUITOUS_LANGUAGE.md) && rg -qi '"'"'reset|recreate'"'"' <(rg '"'"'^\| Schema Compatibility Gate \|'"'"' dev/state/UBIQUITOUS_LANGUAGE.md) && rg -q '"'"'^\| Instance-Local Store \|'"'"' dev/state/UBIQUITOUS_LANGUAGE.md && rg -q '"'"'turn_state\.json'"'"' <(rg '"'"'^\| Instance-Local Store \|'"'"' dev/state/UBIQUITOUS_LANGUAGE.md) && rg -q "^- $(date +%Y-%m-%d):" dev/state/UBIQUITOUS_LANGUAGE.md && ! rg -q '"'"'dartclaw-private|(packages/|package:)dartclaw_(storage|server|config|models|security)\b|S1[0-9]|story S'"'"' dev/state/UBIQUITOUS_LANGUAGE.md'

bash -c 'rg -q '"'"'Phase A delivered'"'"' ../dartclaw-private/docs/ROADMAP.md && rg -qi '"'"'Phase B pending'"'"' ../dartclaw-private/docs/ROADMAP.md && rg -q '"'"'^### 0[.]26 .*Pluggable Database Backend & Multi-Language Search'"'"' dev/state/ROADMAP.md && rg -qi '"'"'Phase A delivered'"'"' <(awk '"'"'/^### 0[.]26 .*Pluggable Database Backend & Multi-Language Search/{f=1;next} /^### /{f=0} f'"'"' dev/state/ROADMAP.md) && rg -qi '"'"'Phase B pending'"'"' <(awk '"'"'/^### 0[.]26 .*Pluggable Database Backend & Multi-Language Search/{f=1;next} /^### /{f=0} f'"'"' dev/state/ROADMAP.md) && rg -q '"'"'PostgreSQL contract'"'"' dev/state/ROADMAP.md && rg -qi '"'"'RELEASE_PREPARATION|confirmed'"'"' <(rg '"'"'PostgreSQL contract'"'"' dev/state/ROADMAP.md) && ! rg -qi '"'"'0\.26 (complete|released|shipped)'"'"' dev/state/ROADMAP.md ../dartclaw-private/docs/ROADMAP.md && ! git diff -U0 -- dev/state/ROADMAP.md | rg '"'"'^\+'"'"' | rg -q '"'"'dartclaw-private/'"'"' && git diff --check && git -C ../dartclaw-private diff --check'
